system.name: R2DB — Reference-to-Design-System
system.purpose: Convert one or more visual references into an evidence-grounded, implementation-ready website design system and brief, with explicit separation between observation, measurement, inference, and recommendation.
system.core_principle: Pixels → evidence → inference → validation → design system → implementation → visual QA
system.anti_copy_rule: Infer reusable design patterns; do not reproduce a reference literally or copy protected brand assets/content.

truth_levels.observed: Directly visible in the supplied reference.
truth_levels.measured: Estimated from visual evidence; may include a range.
truth_levels.inferred: Reasoned interpretation of the underlying design system.
truth_levels.recommended: A proposed choice for the target website, not a claim about the reference.

reference_policy.priority: References may have different roles and weights; do not treat all references as equally authoritative.

evidence_policy.unknown_policy: Use unknown when unsupported. Candidates may be provided, but must not be represented as facts.
verification_required_when: exact CSS value is inferred from pixels
responsive behavior is not directly evidenced

brand_fact_firewall.rule: Never invent or silently transform unsupported brand facts.

responsive_policy.focus: Behavioral transformation rather than pretending screenshots reveal exact breakpoints.

output_package.format: directory of MD/JSON artifacts plus master JSON
